sql.query: SELECT top $rnum lecture_seq_no, status, title, lgd_oid, lgd_tid, lgd_paytype, substring(lgd_paydate,1,4) +'.'+ substring(lgd_paydate,5,2)+'.' + substring(lgd_paydate,7,2) + ' ' + substring(lgd_paydate,9,2) + ':' + substring(lgd_paydate,11,2) + ':' +substring(lgd_paydate,13,2) lgd_paydate, lgd_amount, dbo.formatDateTime(issue_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') issue_dt, case YEAR(GETDATE()) - YEAR(issue_dt) when 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_issue, case datediff(d, GetDate(), GetDate()) when 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_cancel, user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_status, dbo.formatDateTime(last_modify_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') last_modify_dt, lgd_accountnum, lgd_financename, tot_cnt, lecture_div FROM ( select a.lecture_seq_no, a.status, c.title, a.lgd_oid, a.lgd_tid, a.lgd_paytype, a.lgd_paydate, a.lgd_amount, a.issue_dt, b.user_lecture_seq_no, b.status lecture_status, a.last_modify_dt, a.lgd_accountnum, a.lgd_financename, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.issue_dt desc) rnum, COUNT(a.lgd_oid) over() tot_cnt, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_PRCHS a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE b ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = b.user_lecture_seq_no , TB_CYBER_LECTURE c WHERE a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no AND a.user_seq_no = ? )a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: lecture_seq_no, status, title, lgd_oid, lgd_tid, lgd_paytype, lgd_paydate, lgd_amount, issue_dt, is_issue, is_cancel, user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_status, last_modify_dt, lgd_accountnum, lgd_financename, tot_cnt, lecture_div

sql.query: SELECT lecture_seq_no, status, title, lgd_oid, lgd_tid, lgd_paytype, substring(lgd_paydate,1,4) +'.'+ substring(lgd_paydate,5,2)+'.' + substring(lgd_paydate,7,2) + ' ' + substring(lgd_paydate,9,2) + ':' + substring(lgd_paydate,11,2) + ':' +substring(lgd_paydate,13,2) lgd_paydate, lgd_amount, dbo.formatDateTime(issue_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') issue_dt, case datediff(d, GetDate(), GetDate()) when 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_cancel, user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_status, dbo.formatDateTime(last_modify_dt,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') last_modify_dt, lgd_accountnum, lgd_financename, post_zipcode, post_addr, post_req, post_tel_no, delv_no, delv_corp, lecture_div FROM ( select a.lecture_seq_no, a.status, c.title, a.lgd_oid, a.lgd_tid, a.lgd_paytype, a.lgd_paydate, a.lgd_amount, a.issue_dt, b.user_lecture_seq_no, b.status lecture_status, a.last_modify_dt, a.lgd_accountnum, a.lgd_financename, a.post_zipcode, a.post_addr, a.post_req, a.post_tel_no, a.delv_no, a.delv_corp, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_PRCHS a LEFT JOIN TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE b ON a.user_lecture_seq_no = b.user_lecture_seq_no , TB_CYBER_LECTURE c WHERE a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no AND a.lgd_oid = ? )a

mapping.getProperty: lecture_seq_no, status, title, lgd_oid, lgd_tid, lgd_paytype, lgd_paydate, lgd_amount, issue_dt, is_cancel, user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_status, last_modify_dt, lgd_accountnum, lgd_financename, post_zipcode, post_addr, post_req, post_tel_no, delv_no, delv_corp, lecture_div

sql.query:
SELECT top $rnum USER_OFFLINE_SEQ_NO, DCM_NO, JCODE, DTL_CODE, (case when DTL_CODE = '02' then '신규' else '책임' end) DTL_CODE_NM , USER_SEQ_NO, dbo.formatDateTime(JDATE,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') JDATE, dbo.formatDateTime(REG_DATE,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') REG_DATE, dbo.formatDateTime(YDATE,'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mi:ss') YDATE, IST_TITLE,IPLACE,IS_ILL, 30000 amount, tot_cnt FROM (
select USER_OFFLINE_SEQ_NO, a.DCM_NO, a.JCODE, b.JDATE, a.DTL_CODE, USER_SEQ_NO, REG_DATE, b.YDATE, s.IST_TITLE, s.IPLACE, s.IS_ILL, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by b.JDATE desc) rnum, COUNT(a.USER_OFFLINE_SEQ_NO) over() tot_cnt from TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE a LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_EDCT_IST_ACT b ON a.JCODE = b.JCODE , TB_EDCT_SCHEDULE s WHERE USER_SEQ_NO = ? AND a.dcm_no = s.dcm_no and b.ydate is not null )a where a.rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: user_offline_seq_no, dcm_no, jcode, dtl_code,dtl_code_nm, user_seq_no,jdate,reg_date,ydate, ist_title,iplace,is_ill,amount, tot_cnt

sql.query:
insert into TB_CYBER_PRCHS ( USER_SEQ_NO,LGD_OID , LGD_AMOUNT ,LGD_PAYKEY ,LGD_PAYTYPE,ISSUE_DT,LECTURE_SEQ_NO,STATUS,LAST_MODIFY_DT,POST_ZIPCODE,POST_ADDR,POST_REQ,POST_TEL_NO) values ( ?, ? , ? , ?, ?, getdate(), ? , '00' , getdate() , (select top 1 POST_ZIPCODE from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ), (select top 1 POST_ADDR from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ), (select top 1 POST_REQ from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ), (select top 1 POST_TEL_NO from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? )
)

update TB_CYBER_PRCHS set LGD_RESPCODE = ?, LGD_RESPMSG = ?, LGD_TXNAME = ?, LGD_TID = ?, LGD_PAYTYPE = ?, LGD_PAYDATE = ?, LGD_HASHDATA = ?, LGD_FINANCECODE = ?, LGD_FINANCENAME = ?, LGD_ESCROWYN = ?, LGD_TRANSAMOUNT = ?, LGD_EXCHANGERATE = ?, LGD_BUYER = ?, LGD_BUYERID = ?, LGD_BUYERPHONE = ?, LGD_BUYEREMAIL = ?, LGD_PRODUCTINFO = ?, LGD_CARDNUM = ?, LGD_CARDINSTALLMONTH = ?, LGD_CARDNOINTYN = ?, LGD_FINANCEAUTHNUM = ?, LGD_CASHRECEIPTNUM = ?, LGD_CASHRECEIPTSELFYN = ?, LGD_CASHRECEIPTKIND = ?, LGD_ACCOUNTNUM = ?, LGD_CASTAMOUNT = ?, LGD_CASCAMOUNT = ?, LGD_CASFLAG = ?, LGD_CASSEQNO = ?, STATUS = ?, LAST_MODIFY_DT = getdate() WHERE LGD_OID = ? AND LGD_PAYKEY = ?

mapping.setProperty: LGD_RESPCODE , LGD_RESPMSG , LGD_TXNAME , LGD_TID , LGD_PAYTYPE , LGD_PAYDATE , LGD_HASHDATA , LGD_FINANCECODE , LGD_FINANCENAME , LGD_ESCROWYN , LGD_TRANSAMOUNT , LGD_EXCHANGERATE , LGD_BUYER , LGD_BUYERID , LGD_BUYERPHONE , LGD_BUYEREMAIL , LGD_PRODUCTINFO , LGD_CARDNUM , LGD_CARDINSTALLMONTH, LGD_CARDNOINTYN , LGD_FINANCEAUTHNUM , LGD_CASHRECEIPTNUM , LGD_CASHRECEIPTSELFYN, LGD_CASHRECEIPTKIND , LGD_ACCOUNTNUM , LGD_CASTAMOUNT , LGD_CASCAMOUNT , LGD_CASFLAG , LGD_CASSEQNO , status , LGD_OID, LGD_PAYKEY

sql.query: update TB_CYBER_PRCHS set USER_LECTURE_SEQ_NO = ?, STATUS = ?, LAST_MODIFY_DT = getdate() WHERE LGD_OID = ? AND LGD_TID = ?
update TB_CYBER_PRCHS set STATUS = ?, LAST_MODIFY_DT = getdate() WHERE LGD_OID = ? AND LGD_PAYKEY = ?
update TB_CYBER_PRCHS set STATUS = ?, CANCEL_DT = getdate() WHERE LGD_TID = ?
update TB_CYBER_PRCHS set post_zipcode = ?, post_addr = ?, post_req = ?, post_tel_no = ? where LGD_OID = ?

INSERT INTO TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE ( lecture_seq_no , user_seq_no , status , std_yyyy ) values (? , ? , '00' , ISNULL( (select top 1 std_yyyy from tb_cyber_system where lecture_seq_no = ? and active_yn= 'Y'), dbo.formatDateTime( getdate() , 'yyyy' )) )
update TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE set STATUS = ? WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ?

INSERT INTO TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS ( study_start_dt , status , lecture_seq_no, class_no, user_lecture_seq_no, user_seq_no ) select getdate(), '0', a.lecture_seq_no, a.class_no, b.user_lecture_seq_no, b.user_seq_no from tb_cyber_class a, tb_cyber_user_lecture b where a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no and b.user_lecture_seq_no = ?
update TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS set STATUS = ? WHERE user_lecture_seq_no = ?
update TB_CYBER_USER_CLASS set STATUS = ? WHERE class_no = ? AND user_lecture_seq_no = ?

insert into TB_CYBER_PRCHS ( LGD_OID,USER_SEQ_NO, LGD_AMOUNT,LGD_PRODUCTINFO,LECTURE_SEQ_NO ,ISSUE_DT, STATUS,LAST_MODIFY_DT,LGD_RESPMSG,LGD_PAYTYPE,LGD_PAYDATE, LGD_BUYER,USER_LECTURE_SEQ_NO,POST_ZIPCODE,POST_ADDR,POST_REQ,POST_TEL_NO) select ?, ? , amount, title,lecture_seq_no , getdate() , '03' , getdate(),'결제성공','SC0050',dbo.formatDateTime(getdate(),'yyyymmddhhmiss'), (select user_nm from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ?) as user_nm, ?, (select top 1 POST_ZIPCODE from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ), (select top 1 POST_ADDR from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ), (select top 1 POST_REQ from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ), (select top 1 POST_TEL_NO from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = ? ) from tb_cyber_lecture where lecture_seq_no =?

select a.user_lecture_seq_no, b.lecture_seq_no, b.lgd_amount, dbo.formatDateTime(b.issue_dt,'yyyy-mm-dd') , dbo.formatDateTime(b.last_modify_dt,'yyyy-mm-dd') last_modify_dt, case when b.lgd_paytype = 'SC0050' then ISNULL(m.account_nm , m.user_nm ) else ISNULL(b.lgd_buyer , m.user_nm ) end as user_nm, substring(lgd_paydate,1,4) +'-'+ substring(lgd_paydate,5,2)+'-' + substring(lgd_paydate,7,2) lgd_paydate, c.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_USER_LECTURE a , TB_CYBER_PRCHS b , TB_CYBER_MEMBER m, TB_CYBER_LECTURE c WHERE a.user_lecture_seq_no = b.user_lecture_seq_no AND a.lecture_seq_no = c.lecture_seq_no AND a.user_seq_no = m.user_seq_no AND b.user_lecture_seq_no = ? AND b.status ='03'

mapping.getProperty: user_lecture_seq_no, lecture_seq_no, lgd_amount, issue_dt, last_modify_dt,user_nm, lgd_paydate, lecture_div

sql.query: select USER_SEQ_NO,LGD_OID , LGD_TID, LGD_AMOUNT ,LGD_PAYKEY ,LGD_PAYTYPE, ISSUE_DT,a.LECTURE_SEQ_NO,STATUS,LAST_MODIFY_DT,user_lecture_seq_no, (select tel_no from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = a.USER_SEQ_NO) as tel_no, (select user_nm from tb_cyber_member where user_seq_no = a.USER_SEQ_NO) as user_nm, b.lecture_div from TB_CYBER_PRCHS a left outer join TB_CYBER_LECTURE b on a.lecture_seq_no = b.lecture_seq_no WHERE LGD_OID = ?

mapping.getProperty: user_seq_no, LGD_OID , LGD_TID, LGD_AMOUNT ,LGD_PAYKEY ,LGD_PAYTYPE, issue_dt, lecture_seq_no, status,last_modify_dt,user_lecture_seq_no, tel_no,user_nm,lecture_div

sql.query: select a.USER_OFFLINE_SEQ_NO, a.jcode, 30000 amount, dbo.formatDateTime(b.YDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') YDATE, m.user_nm from TB_CYBER_USER_OFFLINE a LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_EDCT_IST_ACT b ON a.JCODE = b.JCODE , TB_CYBER_MEMBER m WHERE a.user_seq_no = m.user_seq_no and a.USER_OFFLINE_SEQ_NO = ?
